_comment: Copy this file to .build-env.local.json and fill in the values. The .local.json variant is gitignored (matches **/*.local in .gitignore). The pre-build hook (frontend/scripts/inject-build-env.mjs) reads it as a fallback when the matching var is not set in process.env — useful for local 'npm run deploy' so devs don't have to export shell vars every session.
_priority: process.env wins over this file. CI sets shell env; local devs use this file.
_source_of_truth: Cloudflare Pages dashboard → hired → Settings → Environment variables → 'production' tab. Public site keys are safe to share within the team.
